MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
OF HARBORLIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.

A Delaware corporation

May 14, 2026

A regular meeting of the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Harborlight Analytics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), was held on May 14, 2026, commencing at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time, at the Company's principal executive offices at 88 Kearny Street, Suite 1400, San Francisco, California, and by videoconference.

1. Notice and Attendance.

Notice of the meeting was given to each director in accordance with Section 3.6 of the Company's bylaws. The following directors were present, constituting a quorum for the transaction of business: Priya Raghavan (Chair), Daniel Okonkwo, Lena Furst, and Thomas Reilly. Director Amaya Cole was absent. Also present, by invitation of the Board, were Sofia Marchetti, Chief Financial Officer, and Grant Wexler of Halloran & Pratt LLP, counsel to the Company. Ms. Raghavan acted as chair of the meeting and Mr. Wexler acted as secretary of the meeting and recorded these minutes.

2. Approval of Prior Minutes.

The chair presented the minutes of the regular meeting of the Board held on February 19, 2026, which had been circulated to the directors in advance of the meeting. Upon motion duly made by Mr. Okonkwo, seconded by Ms. Furst, and unanimously adopted, it was:

RESOLVED, that the minutes of the meeting of the Board held on February 19, 2026 are approved as circulated.

3. Report of the Chief Financial Officer.

Ms. Marchetti reviewed the Company's unaudited financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, reporting revenue of $4,820,000, operating expenses of $5,140,000, and cash and cash equivalents of $11,300,000 as of the quarter end. Ms. Marchetti responded to questions from the directors regarding the Company's projected cash runway. No action was taken.

4. Approval of the Fiscal Year 2027 Operating Budget.

The chair presented the proposed operating budget for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2027, a copy of which is attached to these minutes as Exhibit A. Following discussion, upon motion duly made by Ms. Furst, seconded by Mr. Reilly, and unanimously adopted, it was:

RESOLVED, that the operating budget of the Company for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2027, in substantially the form presented to the Board and attached hereto as Exhibit A, is approved; and

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers of the Company are, and each of them acting alone is, authorized and directed to take all such further action as any of them may deem necessary or advisable to carry out the purposes of the foregoing resolution.

5. Approval of Stock Option Grants.

The chair presented a schedule of proposed stock option grants to twelve employees of the Company, a copy of which is attached to these minutes as Exhibit B. Mr. Wexler advised the Board that the exercise price of each option must be not less than the fair market value of a share of the Company's common stock on the date of grant, and reported that the Board's compensation committee had received an independent valuation dated April 30, 2026 concluding that the fair market value of a share of common stock is $3.15.

Mr. Okonkwo disclosed that his spouse is employed by the Company and is included on the schedule presented, and recused himself from the discussion and the vote on this item. Upon motion duly made by Ms. Furst, seconded by Mr. Reilly, and adopted by the affirmative vote of all directors present other than Mr. Okonkwo, it was:

RESOLVED, that the Company is authorized to grant options to purchase an aggregate of 310,000 shares of the Company's common stock to the individuals, and in the amounts, set forth on Exhibit B, in each case at an exercise price of $3.15 per share, pursuant to and subject to the terms of the Company's 2022 Equity Incentive Plan and the form of stock option agreement previously approved by the Board.

6. Executive Session.

The Board met in executive session, without management or counsel present, from 11:40 a.m. to 11:55 a.m. Pacific Time. No action was taken in executive session.

7. Adjournment.

There being no further business to come before the Board, upon motion duly made, seconded, and unanimously adopted, the meeting was adjourned at 12:05 p.m. Pacific Time.

Respectfully submitted,

/s/ Grant Wexler
Grant Wexler, Secretary of the Meeting

Approved by the Board on August 13, 2026.
